mapper.select: SELECT g.id,g.version,r.capabilities_json,g.scope,s.rule_json,g.valid_to FROM auth_governance.access_grant g JOIN auth_governance.role_version r ON r.id=g.role_id AND r.tenant_id=g.tenant_id AND r.application_id=g.application_id AND r.environment=g.environment LEFT JOIN auth_governance.grant_scope s ON s.grant_id=g.id AND s.tenant_id=g.tenant_id AND s.application_id=g.application_id AND s.environment=g.environment JOIN auth_governance.membership m ON m.id=g.membership_id AND m.tenant_id=g.tenant_id AND m.generation=g.generation JOIN auth_governance.principal u ON u.id=m.principal_id WHERE g.tenant_id=#{p.tenantId} AND g.application_id=#{p.applicationId} AND g.environment=#{p.environment} AND g.membership_id=#{member} AND g.generation=#{generation} AND g.source_type='DIRECT' AND g.state='ACTIVE' AND g.valid_from <=clock_timestamp() AND g.valid_to >clock_timestamp() AND m.status='ACTIVE' AND u.status='ACTIVE' AND u.kind='HUMAN' AND m.valid_from <=clock_timestamp() AND (m.valid_to IS NULL OR m.valid_to >clock_timestamp()) ORDER BY g.id LIMIT 101
